pin_rule: Each list is read at its newest recorded pin (the Q1-2 PROPOSAL default); every older recorded census is re-read at its own pin as provenance. A list with no recorded pin is read at the default-branch head fetched for this ledger.
boundaries: unauthenticated depth-1 partial clones; no GitHub API; no cloned code executed
a list whose external_resources pass stops on a link urlsplit refuses is read again with only those links skipped; extraction.ignored counts them
external entries are seeded by canonical URL; an IP literal, localhost or a private suffix is no public candidate and is counted under seeded_occurrences.external_not_public

g5_generic_ledger.layer_ids_note: run() adds the native survivor review's layers for its reviewed candidates (screen_generic.py:358-366); this ledger does not read that review
